title: Gwaith Mynyddog. Cyfrol II
summary: "Gwaith Mynyddog. Cyfrol II" by Mynyddog is a collection of poems published in 1915. This volume presents 77 previously unpublished poems by Richard Davies (Mynyddog), one of Wales's most popular Victorian-era poets. Edited by D. Emlyn Evans and completed by O.M. Edwards, the collection features diverse poetic forms including englynion, hymns, humorous verses, and patriotic songs.
